<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (data)>

    xml:space (default|preserve) #IMPLIED>
]>
<root xml:base="documents/" xml:lang="en" xml:space="preserve">

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST book id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!PI processing-instruction-target data="processing-instruction-value"?>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
]>
<catalog>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="print.css"?>
  <book id="bk101">
    <title>XML Processing Guide</title>
    <author>Expert Fuzzer</author>
    <price>49.99</price>
  </book>
</catalog>
```
